name: phr-foundry
description: PeoplesHR internal Claude Code marketplace. Distributes organization standards and tooling to engineering teams.

plugins.name: org-standards
plugins.description: PeoplesHR organization standards. Ships the hrm_deployment_script skill for reformatting SQL to PHR conventions in .NET Framework projects, the sql_standards_review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, the phx_debugger skill for fixing an Azure DevOps bug end to end from its bug ID, and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a database's schema.
